comedyScripts.hook: Mi abuela me pregunto que hago de trabajo y...
comedyScripts.script: Open with you on FaceTime with 'abuela' (or just reacting). She asks in Spanish what you do. You try to explain: 'Soy modelo... y tengo una agencia de AI...' Cut to confused face. You switch to English to explain to the camera: 'She thinks I sell computers.' End with her saying 'Ay mija, pero cuando te casas?'
comedyScripts.visual: Split between FaceTime POV and direct-to-camera reaction. Cozy apartment setting.

comedyScripts.hook: POV: The brand thinks this is my life...
comedyScripts.script: LEFT SIDE: You in full glam, perfect lighting, sipping coffee in a pristine apartment, leisurely scrolling through brand offers. RIGHT SIDE: Reality — you in sweats, hair up, laptop on the bed surrounded by snacks, frantically editing at 2am while 47 tabs are open.
comedyScripts.visual: Split screen. One side filtered/glamorous, other side raw/chaotic. Quick cuts.
comedyScripts.audio: Dramatic music for glamour side, chaos music for reality

comedyScripts.hook: Getting ready for a casting at 6am vs getting ready for the club at 10pm
comedyScripts.script: 6AM: Zombie mode. Under-eye patches. Chugging coffee. Outfit is 'whatever is clean.' Barely functioning. Monotone voiceover: 'This is fashion.' 10PM: FULL GLAM TRANSFORMATION. Hair done, makeup flawless, outfit fire. Night and day difference. Energy shift is the comedy.
comedyScripts.visual: Start dark/unglamorous. Time lapse through the day. End with glamorous evening look. Quick transition.

comedyScripts.hook: The email said 'great exposure opportunity' and my rent said...
comedyScripts.script: Show yourself opening an email excited. Read out loud: 'We'd love to offer you amazing exposure to our 500 followers!' Cut to your face dropping. Cut to a mock 'rent due' notification on your phone. Cut back to you typing a professional decline. Inner monologue voiceover: 'Exposure doesn't pay for this NYC apartment.'
comedyScripts.visual: Phone screen recordings (mocked up). Your facial reactions. NYC apartment in background for context.
comedyScripts.audio: Original audio or trending 'record scratch' sound

comedyScripts.hook: My morning routine running 4 businesses (it's not cute)
comedyScripts.script: Alarm at 5am — groan. Check emails for brand deals (model brain). Open Nuvana dashboard (CEO brain). Reply to Storytime Miami messages (sales brain). Restaurant marketing review (client brain). Somewhere in between: coffee, skincare, outfit selection. End with: 'And people ask why I'm tired.' Cut to you already dressed and walking out fabulous.
comedyScripts.visual: Fast cuts. Multiple screens/devices. Messy desk that gets progressively more chaotic. Final shot: looking put together despite the chaos.

comedyScripts.hook: Let me translate brand emails for you...
comedyScripts.script: Show email screenshots (mock or blurred real ones). Read what the email SAYS vs what it MEANS. 'We have a limited budget' = 'We want free content.' 'We're looking for a long-term partnership' = 'We want 10 posts for the price of 1.' 'We love your aesthetic' = 'We haven't actually looked at your page.' You react to each one.
comedyScripts.visual: Screen recordings of 'emails' with your face in corner reacting. Text overlays with the 'translation.'
comedyScripts.audio: Original — your commentary IS the audio

comedyScripts.hook: The wildest thing that ever happened to me at a casting...
comedyScripts.script: Do your makeup while telling a real (or slightly exaggerated) casting story. Build suspense. Maybe they asked you to do something weird, or you showed up to the wrong address, or you ran into your ex. The story drives the video; the GRWM gives it visual momentum.
comedyScripts.visual: Standard GRWM setup — mirror, good lighting, makeup application. But the story is the star.

comedyScripts.hook: When you code-switch mid-sentence and confuse everyone at the meeting...
comedyScripts.script: You're in a 'meeting' (or on a call). Start professional in English. Someone says something that triggers a reaction and you slip into Spanish without realizing it. Cut to confused faces. You catch yourself: 'Sorry, sorry — what I MEANT was...' Then slip into Spanish again. End with: 'This is what happens when you're bilingual in corporate America.'
comedyScripts.visual: Office/professional setting. Multiple 'reaction' angles from confused colleagues (could be you playing multiple parts).
comedyScripts.audio: Original — the language switching IS the comedy

comedyScripts.hook: 5 things Costa Rica did NOT prepare me for in New York
comedyScripts.script: Quick cuts with text overlays. 1) The cold. Show you bundled up looking miserable. 2) The rent. Show fake apartment listing: '400 sq ft — $3,500.' 3) The pace. Everyone speed-walking, you trying to keep up. 4) The dating. Just a confused face. 5) People not knowing where Costa Rica is. 'No, it's not in Mexico.' End with: 'But I wouldn't change it.'
comedyScripts.visual: Quick cuts between NYC footage and your reactions. Text overlays for each point.

comedyScripts.hook: GRWM but explaining how I negotiate brand deals
comedyScripts.script: Do your makeup while dramatizing a negotiation. 'So they offered me $200. I put on my mascara and said...' Dramatic pause. 'That won't work for me.' Show the back-and-forth escalation comically. Each makeup step = a negotiation tactic. Lipstick = the final number. 'And THAT is how you close a deal.'
comedyScripts.visual: GRWM format but each makeup product represents a negotiation move. Dramatic pauses, confident energy.

comedyScripts.hook: POV: Your tia sees your Instagram for the first time
comedyScripts.script: You hand your phone to 'tia.' She starts scrolling. Her reactions escalate: 'Ay que bonita!' Then: 'Mija, why are you in a bikini?' Then: 'How much do they PAY you for this?!' Then: 'Can you get me free stuff?' End with her following you and liking every photo.
comedyScripts.visual: Over-the-shoulder phone scrolling POV. Your reactions in corner or alternating shots.

comedyScripts.hook: What I ordered vs what I got but it's brand gifting packages
comedyScripts.script: Show expectations: massive PR box, confetti, full product line, handwritten note. Reality: A tiny envelope with one lip gloss sample and a card that says 'We love your content!' Compare multiple brands. End with the ONE brand that actually sent an amazing package (shout them out — they'll repost).
comedyScripts.visual: Unboxing format. Dramatic reveal. Split between expectation and reality.

comedyScripts.hook: My screen time report just EXPOSED me
comedyScripts.script: Open your screen time report (mock it up). React dramatically to each app. 'Instagram: 6 hours. That's... research.' 'TikTok: 4 hours. Content analysis.' 'Gmail: 3 hours. Being a CEO.' 'Netflix: 2 hours. THAT WAS AN ACCIDENT.' Total: 15 hours. 'I run 4 businesses, this is normal.'
comedyScripts.visual: Phone screen recording of screen time. Your face reacting. Text overlays with your 'justifications.'

comedyScripts.hook: NYC subway but make it a runway
comedyScripts.script: Dramatic slow-mo walk through an actual NYC subway station. Full outfit, confidence, maybe a hair flip. Then reality cuts in: someone bumps into you. A rat runs by. The train is delayed. You're sweating. But you still look good. End with: 'The real New York Fashion Week is the daily commute.'
comedyScripts.visual: Cinematic slow-mo mixed with chaotic reality footage. High contrast between glamour and grit.
comedyScripts.audio: Runway music that abruptly switches to chaos

comedyScripts.hook: Explaining AI to my family in Costa Rica
comedyScripts.script: FaceTime with family. Try to explain Nuvana. 'Es una agencia de AI...' 'QUE ES AI?' 'Inteligencia artificial...' 'COMO EN LAS PELICULAS?!' 'No abuela, no es Terminator...' They think you're building robots. Your cousin asks if it can do their homework. Your mom asks if it's safe. End with: 'They don't get it but they shared it with everyone they know.'
comedyScripts.visual: FaceTime POV with family reactions. Subtitle the Spanish parts.

comedyScripts.hook: When the photographer says 'give me natural' and you've been posing for 10 years
comedyScripts.script: Photographer: 'Just be natural!' You: frozen in an obviously practiced pose. Try another 'natural' pose — still looks staged. Try walking 'naturally' — it's a runway walk. Try laughing 'naturally' — it's a catalog laugh. End with genuinely laughing at yourself — photographer: 'PERFECT!'
comedyScripts.visual: Photo shoot setting. Quick cuts between your 'natural' attempts. End with the genuine moment.

comedyScripts.hook: The time a brand asked me to work for FREE and what happened next...
comedyScripts.script: GRWM while telling the story. Brand reached out, loved your work, wanted a full campaign. You sent rates. They said 'We don't have budget but it'll be great exposure.' You politely declined. Two weeks later they came back with budget. Lesson: 'Know your worth and the right brands will pay it.' Keep it funny, not bitter.
comedyScripts.visual: Standard GRWM. Your expressions tell the story — the initial excitement, the disappointment, the pride in saying no, the satisfaction of them coming back.

comedyScripts.hook: A regular Monday in the life of a model/CEO/content creator
comedyScripts.script: Speed-run through your actual Monday. Every hour gets 3-5 seconds. 6am: gym. 7am: emails. 8am: Nuvana call. 9am: casting. 11am: content filming. 1pm: lunch (Carrot Express obviously). 2pm: brand meeting. 4pm: edit content. 6pm: restaurant marketing review. 8pm: collapse. Add comedy captions to each segment.
comedyScripts.visual: Fast cuts, time stamps, chaotic but aesthetic. iPhone footage mixed with styled shots.

comedyScripts.hook: Nobody prepared me for dating in NYC as a Latina model
comedyScripts.script: Show a series of dating scenarios with comedic text overlays. Date says: 'So you're a model? That's cool.' What he means: 'I'm going to tell all my friends.' His face when you say you run an AI company. His face when the check comes and you offer to split (but he insists). The group chat update after. Your mom asking about him 5 minutes later.
comedyScripts.visual: Quick scene changes. Text overlays for inner monologue. Group chat mockups.

comedyScripts.hook: GRWM but I'm manifesting where I'll be in one year
comedyScripts.script: Do your makeup while talking about your one-year vision. Keep it confident but funny. 'By next March I want Nuvana to have X clients. I want to have closed deals with X brands. I want my engagement rate to be X.' Each goal gets more ambitious. End with: 'And if none of that happens, at least my makeup will look good.' Save this and do a follow-up in one year.
comedyScripts.visual: Standard GRWM. Calm, confident energy with moments of humor. Vision board or text overlays with goals.

engagementChecklist: Add captions/subtitles to EVERY video (80% higher completion)
Reply to every comment in the FIRST HOUR after posting
Use keywords in on-screen text (Social SEO — TikTok is a search engine)
Post to TikTok first, bring winners to IG 24-48 hours later
NEVER post with TikTok watermark on IG (or vice versa)
Use Instagram Stories daily: polls, Q&As, emoji sliders
Create content people want to SEND to a friend
Film in batches: 3-4 videos in one sitting
End every video with ONE clear CTA
Use specific CTAs: 'Comment YES' beats 'Link in bio'

pitchTemplates.name: Cold Outreach to Brands
pitchTemplates.useCase: Reaching out to a fashion/beauty brand you want to work with
pitchTemplates.subject: Collaboration Opportunity — Catalina Freer x [Brand Name]
pitchTemplates.body:
Hi [Name],

I'm Catalina Freer — a model and content creator with 1M+ combined followers across Instagram and TikTok. I've created content for Chanel, Skims, Revolve, Valentino, and Four Seasons, and I bring campaign-level creative quality to every collaboration.

I love what [Brand] is doing with [specific campaign/product] and I think my audience — a multicultural community spanning the US, Latin America, and Europe — would be the perfect fit.

I'd love to explore a partnership. My rates start at $1,000 for a single image post and $1,800 for a Reel that cross-posts to TikTok (700K followers), giving you reach across both platforms. I also offer a full campaign package at $4,000 that includes a post, reel, and carousel across both platforms.

Would you be open to a quick chat this week? Happy to share my media kit.

Best,
Catalina Freer
+1 323-681-8164
catalinafreer.com
pitchTemplates.angles: Lead with resume (Chanel, Skims, etc). Mention cross-platform value. Offer package deal.

pitchTemplates.name: Response to Brand Inquiry
pitchTemplates.useCase: Brand reached out asking about rates or availability
pitchTemplates.subject: Re: [Their Subject Line]
pitchTemplates.body:
Hi [Name],

Thank you so much for reaching out — I'm very excited about the possibility of working with [Brand]!

Here are my current rates:
• Single Image Post: $1,000
• Carousel Post: $1,500
• Reel (IG + TikTok cross-post): $1,800
• Full Campaign (Image + Reel + Carousel): $4,000

All content is cross-posted to TikTok where I have 700K followers, so you get exposure across both platforms at no additional cost.

I'd love to hear more about your campaign timeline and deliverables. Happy to also share my media kit with full audience demographics.

Best,
Catalina Freer
pitchTemplates.angles: Always mention TikTok cross-posting. Offer package deal. Ask about timeline to move conversation forward.

pitchTemplates.name: Negotiating Up From Low Offer
pitchTemplates.useCase: Brand offered less than your rates
pitchTemplates.subject: Re: [Their Subject Line]
pitchTemplates.body:
Hi [Name],

Thank you for this opportunity — I really love what [Brand] is doing and I'd love to find a way to make this work!

For the scope you've described, my rate would be $[your rate]. This includes cross-posting to TikTok (700K followers) and full creative direction, so you're getting multi-platform reach and high-quality content.

If budget is a consideration, I'd be happy to explore a package deal — my Full Campaign rate is $4,000 and includes a post, reel, and carousel across both platforms, which often gives brands the best return on investment.

I've done similar campaigns for Chanel, Revolve, and Four Seasons and I'm confident we can create something amazing together. Let me know what works for your team!

Best,
Catalina Freer
pitchTemplates.angles: Acknowledge their budget respectfully. Counter with value (cross-platform, creative direction). Offer package as alternative. Name-drop past brands.

pitchTemplates.name: Pitching Comedy Content
pitchTemplates.subject: Content Idea: [Brand] x Catalina Freer — Comedy Reel Concept
pitchTemplates.body:
Hi [Name],

I have a content concept for [Brand] that I think could really resonate.

My comedy and lifestyle content has been performing incredibly well lately — my humor-driven Reels consistently outperform traditional sponsored content in engagement and shares. Brands are seeing that entertaining content gets shared in DMs (the #1 algorithm signal on both IG and TikTok), which means more organic reach for your brand.

Here's the concept: [Brief 2-sentence pitch of the comedy angle — e.g., 'A comedy skit about what influencers ACTUALLY do when they get a product they love vs. the polished version brands usually see. Think behind-the-scenes humor that makes your product the hero of a relatable moment.']

My Reel rate is $1,800 and includes TikTok cross-posting (700K followers). For a series of 3 comedy Reels, I offer a discounted package.

Would love to discuss! Happy to share examples of my recent comedy content.

Best,
Catalina Freer
pitchTemplates.angles: Position comedy as a STRATEGY, not just entertainment. Mention DM shares as algorithm advantage. Offer series discount.

pitchTemplates.name: Bilingual/Multicultural Campaign Pitch
pitchTemplates.useCase: Pitching to brands wanting to reach Latin American or multicultural audiences
pitchTemplates.subject: Reaching Latin American & Multicultural Audiences — Catalina Freer
pitchTemplates.body:
Hi [Name],

I'm reaching out because I think [Brand] has an incredible opportunity to connect with Latin American and multicultural audiences — and I'd love to help make that happen.

As a Costa Rican model and content creator based in NYC, I have a unique audience that most creators can't offer:
• 700K TikTok followers with 62% Costa Rica / 13% US audience
• 302K Instagram followers spanning the US, Latin America, and Europe
• Fully bilingual (English/Spanish) content that resonates authentically with both markets

My bilingual content consistently outperforms single-language posts because it creates genuine connection with Latin audiences while remaining accessible to English-speaking viewers.

I've created content for Chanel, Skims, Revolve, and Four Seasons, and I bring the same campaign-level quality to every collaboration. Rates start at $1,800 for a Reel across both platforms.

Would love to explore a partnership that speaks to your multicultural audience. Happy to share my media kit.

Best,
Catalina Freer
catalinafreer.com
pitchTemplates.angles: Lead with the multicultural audience data. Position bilingual content as a strategic advantage. Emphasize authentic connection with Latin consumers.
